title: Reading Between the Tweets: Deciphering Ideological Stances of Interconnected Mixed-Ideology Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Finetuning GPT-2 on tweets from interconnected mixed-ideology communities using message passing, generating responses about politically salient targets (political figures and social groups), and calculating the sentiment of the generated responses to compare with ground-truth ideological stances from the 2020 ANES survey.
